about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (2 Kings 4:1–37) mirrors Sarah’s story. A childless woman of Shunem is promised a son “at this season next year.” When the boy dies, God raises him through Elisha. The reading from the Apostles (Hebrews 11:8–19) takes us to the Akedah. By faith Abraham offered Isaac, reasoning that God was able even to raise him from the dead.
